# Maxey0 for ChatGPT

Governed context and execution for agents: an explicit SCW address space, a gate at every tool call and every model egress, and a hash-chained record of both.

**The artifact here is complete. Listing it is a platform action this repository cannot perform, and does not claim.**

## Install

```
Settings → Connectors → Add: https://mcp.maxey0.com/mcp
```

A ChatGPT app is an MCP server plus a manifest; both are here. Submission and review are OpenAI's and are not claimed here.
